item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 23/Apr/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A humid southerly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. There will be a few showers over the region. With the anticyclone aloft strengthening gradually, it will be generally fine and hot over the coastal areas of southern China in the middle and latter parts of next week.

Date/Month: 24/04 (Sunday)
Wind: South force 2 to 3.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with one or two showers. Coastal fog in the morning and at night. Sunny periods during the day.
Temp range: 24 - 30 C
R.H. range: 65 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Low
